assumptions.description: Assume a conditional natural-lognormal distribution with normal independent residuals. Taiwan raw mean 7.1 and SD 4.14 imply total log variance log(1+(4.14/7.1)^2). This is a moment-matched approximation, not a reported log SD.

Assume log BMI and raw glucose jointly normal with correlation 0.25 and age independent of both. Assume latent log-insulin/log-BMI correlation 0.50, contextually informed by MACAD transformed-trait R=0.56, but not equal to an identified conditional effect. Convert Taiwan raw insulin/glucose and insulin/age correlations under the joint-normal/lognormal approximation, then solve the two-predictor covariance equations. None of the resulting conditional coefficients is a published regression.

Assume female-versus-male log insulin shift 0.08. MACAD female median 12.0 versus male 11.3 provides contextual scale only: unadjusted sex medians and their covariate differences cannot identify an adjusted sex effect. Center using Taiwan reported male fraction and subtract assumed sex contribution from residual variance.

Transfer the Taiwan mean/dispersion and approximate conditional structure to the requested adults, despite ancestry, age, diabetes, fasting protocol and assay differences. MACAD informs BMI structure and provides a separate marginal diagnostic. No source specifies a valid target-population conditional distribution.

Outside source support, BMI is evaluated on log scale with 12 to 65 kg/m2 caps. Glucose enters linearly from 50 to 126 mg/dL; above 126 its incremental contribution is 0.35*30*(1-exp(-(g-126)/30)), saturated at glucose 180. These explicit bounded extrapolation choices avoid exponential glucose escalation and do not claim evidence for diabetic physiology or beta-cell failure.

Approximate source covariates with 10000 pseudo-person rows: BMI lognormal moment-matched to 24.36 (SD 3.53), glucose normal 89.1 (SD 9.93), age normal 63.91 (SD 8.32), male fraction 0.346; logBMI/glucose correlation 0.25; independent age and sex. Clip glucose to 50-125.9, BMI 12-65, age 50-79 and round age. Original source included ages 80-90, which task contract cannot represent. Repeat simulation rows do not increase evidence sample size above n=321. Full source selection and joint distribution are unobserved.

Approximate MACAD using 10000 independent pseudo-person rows with male fraction 197/470; sex-specific reported medians/IQR widths; age/glucose normal with SD=IQR/1.3489795003921634; BMI lognormal with log SD=asinh(IQR/(2*median))/0.6744897501960817. Assign correlation 0.25 between log BMI and glucose and independent age; clip age to 20-79, glucose 50-125.9, BMI 12-65. Joint distribution, family dependence, exclusions and source age tails cannot be reconstructed. IQR widths are not reported SDs or endpoints; conversions here are assumptions.

For replay, map source fasting_insulin to fasting_insulin_uU_ml, age to age_years, BMI to bmi_kg_m2, and fasting_glucose to fasting_glucose_mg_dl. microU/mL, microIU/mL and uU/mL are nominal insulin activity-unit aliases; assay and four-draw versus single-draw differences remain uncorrected, not established measurement equivalence.
Source median interpolation convention is unreported. Replay uses linear sample quantiles as an approximation.
Seeds vary individual residual draws only, not source estimates, model structure or transport. Source pseudo-covariates are fixed using seed 71409; model uncertainty is not calibrated.

reference_insulin_mean.derivation: Reported raw arithmetic mean; used to derive log intercept.

total_log_variance.derivation: log(1+(4.14/7.1)^2), where 4.14 is reported raw SD, not SE.

bmi_log_coefficient.derivation: With sY=sqrt(total_log_variance), sB=sqrt(log(1+(3.53/24.36)^2)), rGI=0.38*(4.14/7.1)/sY, assumed rBI=0.50 and rBG=0.25: ((rBI-rBG*rGI)/(1-rBG^2))*sY/sB.

age_coefficient.derivation: -0.04*(4.14/7.1)/8.32; assumes age independent of other predictors.

female_log_shift.derivation: 0.08 is an explicit adjusted-effect assumption, contextually informed by unadjusted sex medians.

residual_log_sd.derivation: Square root of total log variance minus the assumed predictor-explained log variance and sex variance; computed from declared covariance assumptions.

glucose_knots.derivation: Explicit unsupported bounded-extrapolation choice; see A_tails.

glucose_tail_scale.derivation: Explicit unsupported bounded-extrapolation choice; see A_tails.

glucose_tail_weight.derivation: Explicit unsupported bounded-extrapolation choice; see A_tails.

bmi_bounds.derivation: Explicit unsupported bounded-extrapolation choice; see A_tails.

source_context_recipe.derivation: Source covariates only; fixed pseudo-population reconstruction. Original source row counts are retained in source records, not replaced by simulation count.
